about: Decisions on the restrict and restrict_span candidates that harness/check_const_restrict.py (E3) reports, matched by path, function, outputs and kind. apply: GUI_FORMS_RESTRICT (or the package's STX_<PKG>_RESTRICT) is on the parameters of an internal kernel, under a written overlap rule checked by an overlap assertion in debug and sanitizer builds. keep: restrict stays out, for the reason given.

decisions.reason: Fuzz harness: the buffers are only passed on to DeflateStream; the stream's own process entries carry the decision.
Public header (include/gui_forms/anatomy): restrict stays out of public signatures until reviewed.
Restricted parameters on the internal distribute_remaining_parts; the wrapper asserts the caller's specs and the result's tracks disjoint.
Declared in a public header (TableLayoutPanelCompat::resolve_tracks): restrict stays out of public signatures until reviewed.
Restricted parameters on the internal across_rows; box_across asserts from and to disjoint (work.first and work.second are separate vectors).
Restricted parameters on the internal down_rows; box_down asserts from, to and the column sums pairwise disjoint (three separate vectors).
Restricted parameters on the internal copy_line; resample_one_line asserts to disjoint from from and positions (separate VariantWork vectors). The interpolation seam takes spans unchanged.
Restricted parameters on the internal fill_grapheme_parts; the wrapper asserts text, scalars and boundaries pairwise disjoint (separate allocations and the caller's text).

Restricted parameters on Impl::fill_bounded_parts; the wrapper asserts the four scratch arrays disjoint from each other and from the text and edges (separate allocations). candidates stays a span of const face pointers.
Public C ABI entry point: the signature is fixed by the C API, and restrict stays out of public signatures until reviewed.

Public stb_vorbis-compatible C entry point: the signature is fixed by that API, and restrict stays out of public signatures until reviewed.
Restricted parameters on the internal unfilter_up_bytes; unfilter_up asserts row and previous disjoint (two separate rows of decode_image's storage).
Restricted parameters on the internal unfilter_left_bytes; unfilter_left asserts row and previous disjoint (previous is empty for filter 1).
Restricted parameters on the internal scatter_samples; scatter asserts the filtered row and RGBA samples disjoint (prepare_decode rejects overlapping caller buffers).

It reaches its buffers through InflateStream::process (stx_zlib, compiled separately), whose stream keeps its own state across calls; a restricted parameter here would also bind the stream's accesses, which this function's overlap rule cannot show. The byte loops it drives (unfilter_up, unfilter_left, scatter) carry restricted parameters.
